title: Icy's Mini Album Vol.1
content:
More than twenty years ago, YURI NO1's Creator had a wish:

To see her.

Someday in the future, with the best technology available, that girl would finally be drawn as she had always existed in the Creator's mind.

And there was another wish that came later:

To hear her sing.

In this era, technology has finally made it possible for YURI NO1's Creator to realize those wishes independently.

The girl who had been etched into the Creator's mind for so many years now has an image.

She has a voice.

“Yes.

That’s her.”

And the Creator can recognize her.

Icy’s first AI solo mini album is now in planning and production.

AI answered a miracle that YURI NO1's Creator needed—

within the Creator's own lifetime.

And one question remains:

Can something be left behind in this digital ocean?

Those completely unique realizations born from a miracle, from YURI NO1's Creator, and from AI.

And there is still one more wish.

To see her walking closer.

Right there, in front of the Creator.

Not inside a screen.

She would still be the two-dimensional version of herself.

Not a three-dimensional person.

And yet, across dimensions,

the two would look into each other’s eyes.

Someday.
